_meta.source: Written for claudeDM (Sci-Fi category). Mostly original; a few general-mechanics sentences (e.g. opportunity attacks, passive checks, stat-block phrasing) are adapted from SRD 5.1, licensed CC BY 4.0 — see NOTICE.
_meta.notes: Adventuring gear for Sci-Fi campaigns, era-tagged. Costs are in dollars for items available in the 1980s/modern eras and in credits for future-only items (a credits campaign may price multi-era items at 1 cr = $1). Ammunition is recorded on character sheets as counted equipment lines such as "9mm rounds (45)" and deducted shot by shot (see combat.json ammunition). Medical items implement the no-magic healing rules in combat.json healing.

gear.name: Walkie-talkie (pair)
gear.description: Handheld radios with a range of about 2 miles in a city, 5 in open country. Anyone with a scanner on the channel can listen in.

gear.name: Military field radio
gear.description: Backpack radio with a range of 20 miles and encrypted channels (Computers DC 20 to intercept).

gear.name: Police scanner
gear.description: Listen to police, fire and ambulance radio. Gives advantage on checks to anticipate a police response.

gear.name: Pager
gear.description: Receives numeric messages; you find a payphone to call back.

gear.name: Brick cellphone
gear.description: Late-1980s car or bag phone. Works only in major cities; the battery lasts about 30 minutes of talk.

gear.name: Smartphone
gear.description: Calls, messages, maps, camera, internet. Can be tracked by anyone with police or carrier access (Computers DC 15). Counts as a consumer device for hacking (DC 10).

gear.name: Burner phone
gear.description: Prepaid phone bought with cash. Hard to link to you unless it is used near your own phone.

gear.name: Earpiece comm
gear.description: Bone-conduction earbud with a 10-mile mesh range; links squad members and their HUDs.

gear.name: Comm unit
gear.description: Wrist or palm device: voice, video, data, local network, translator for common human languages.

gear.name: Field dressing
gear.description: Single-use bandage. As an action, end Bleeding on a creature without a check.

gear.name: Medkit
gear.description: First aid supplies. Gives advantage on Medicine checks to stabilize; required for the Medic's Field Medicine. 10 uses.

gear.name: Trauma kit
gear.description: Tourniquets, chest seals, IV fluids. As an action, a creature proficient in Medicine can treat a creature that has been at 0 HP for under 1 minute: it becomes stable and regains 1 HP. 3 uses.

gear.name: Painkillers
gear.description: A dose taken as an action grants 1d4 + 1 temporary hit points for 1 hour and ends the Shaken condition. A second dose within 8 hours: CON save DC 12 or poisoned for 1 hour.

gear.name: Adrenaline auto-injector
gear.description: As an action, inject a creature at 0 HP: it is stable and regains 1 HP. Once per creature per long rest.

gear.name: Med-stim
gear.description: Bonus action, self or adjacent creature: regain 2d4 + 2 HP. A creature can take 3 stims per long rest safely; each one beyond that requires a DC 12 CON save or the creature gains 1 level of exhaustion.

gear.name: Combat stim
gear.description: Bonus action: for 1 minute you have advantage on STR and DEX checks and saves and +10 ft speed. When it wears off, CON save DC 13 or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

gear.name: Antitoxin
gear.description: Advantage on saves against poison for 1 hour; ends the poisoned condition from a toxin taken in the last minute.

gear.name: Gas mask
gear.description: Immunity to inhaled gases (tear gas, smoke, most toxins). Disadvantage on Perception checks that rely on sight while worn.

gear.name: Rebreather mask
gear.description: Filters toxic atmospheres and supplies 1 hour of air in vacuum or underwater.

gear.name: Lockpicks
gear.description: Pick mechanical locks with a DEX (Sleight of Hand) or INT (Mechanics) check; proficiency with lockpicks adds your proficiency bonus. Without lockpicks, mechanical locks can't be picked.

gear.name: Electronic lock bypass
gear.description: Keypad and card-reader shim. Advantage on Mechanics or Computers checks to open electronic locks.

gear.name: Mechanic's tools
gear.description: Wrenches, sockets, screwdrivers. Required for most Mechanics repairs and Jury-Rig without penalty (otherwise disadvantage).

gear.name: Electronics toolkit
gear.description: Soldering iron, multimeter, wire, components. Required for electronic repairs, bugs and alarms without disadvantage.

gear.name: Hacking rig
gear.description: 1980s: acoustic-coupler modem, handheld terminal, line-tap clips. Modern: laptop with exploit kits and a wireless adapter. Future: neural deck with intrusion software. Lacking one, Computers checks against secured systems have disadvantage.

gear.name: Laboratory kit
gear.description: Portable chemistry and biology lab. Analyze samples, identify toxins and synthesize simple compounds.

gear.name: Pharmacology kit
gear.description: Reference drugs and testing reagents. Identify drugs and toxins; prepare painkillers or sedatives with a Medicine or Science check.

gear.name: Disguise kit
gear.description: Makeup, wigs, prosthetics and costume pieces. Proficiency adds your bonus to checks to create a disguise.

gear.name: Forgery kit
gear.description: Papers, inks, laminator or printer, stamps. Proficiency adds your bonus to create false documents; scrutinizing one is Investigation against your forgery check.

gear.name: Camera kit
gear.description: Camera body, lenses and film or memory cards. Long lens: photograph clear details at 300 ft.

gear.name: Navigation kit
gear.description: Maps, compass, protractor, altimeter. Advantage on Survival checks to navigate without electronics.

gear.name: Multitool
gear.description: Pliers, blades and drivers in one; substitutes for mechanic's tools on simple tasks (DC 10 or less).

gear.name: Duct tape
gear.description: Binds a creature's wrists (escape DC 13) or holds anything together for an hour.

gear.name: Handcuffs
gear.description: Restrain a grappled or incapacitated creature (action). Escape: DEX (Sleight of Hand) DC 20 or STR DC 25; lockpicks DC 15.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.description: Advantage on STR checks where leverage helps. Also a melee weapon (see equipment.json).

gear.name: Bolt cutters
gear.description: Cut chains, padlocks and fences as an action (STR DC 10).

gear.name: Binoculars
gear.description: See distant objects as if 10 times closer. Advantage on Perception checks to spot things more than 300 ft away.

gear.name: Night-vision goggles
gear.description: Darkvision 60 ft (1980s: 40 ft and a visible green glow if anyone looks for it). A flashbang or bright light while worn imposes disadvantage on the save.

gear.name: Thermal scope
gear.description: Mounted on a Longarm: see warm bodies through smoke and darkness to 300 ft; half cover from foliage or smoke doesn't apply against your shots. Zombies and robots show as cold.

gear.name: Rifle scope
gear.description: Mounted on a Longarm: when you Aim, you also ignore disadvantage for attacking at long range.

gear.name: Bug (listening device)
gear.description: Planted with Sleight of Hand. Transmits audio to a receiver within 1,000 ft (1980s) or over the network (modern/future). Battery lasts 1 week.

gear.name: Bug detector
gear.description: Advantage on checks to find bugs, trackers and hidden cameras.

gear.name: GPS tracker
gear.description: Magnetic tracker reporting location to your phone or comm. In the 1980s use a radio beacon with a 1-mile range instead.

gear.name: Camera drone
gear.description: Remote quadcopter: AC 13, HP 5, fly 60 ft, 20-minute battery, 2-mile range. Piloting checks to fly it in combat or wind.

gear.name: Motion tracker
gear.description: Shows movement of Small or larger objects within 100 ft as blips (distance and direction, not identity). Walls don't block it. Beeps unless muted.

gear.name: Flashlight
gear.description: Bright light in a 60-ft cone and dim light for another 60 ft. Can be taped to a weapon.

gear.name: Weapon light
gear.description: Rail-mounted flashlight. Shining it into a creature's eyes (bonus action) gives disadvantage on its next attack against you unless it succeeds on a DC 10 CON save.

gear.name: Chemical light stick
gear.description: Dim light in a 10-ft radius for 6 hours.

gear.name: Road flare
gear.description: Bright red light in a 30-ft radius for 15 minutes; can ignite flammable material.

gear.name: Rope (50 ft)
gear.description: Nylon climbing rope; holds 1,000 lb.

gear.name: Grappling hook
gear.description: Thrown 30 ft up or across; DEX (Acrobatics) DC 10 to catch.

gear.name: Climbing harness and gear
gear.description: Advantage on Athletics checks to climb with rope; prevents falls if anchored.

gear.name: Backpack
gear.description: Holds about 1 cubic foot / 30 lb of gear.

gear.name: Bedroll or sleeping bag
gear.description: Allows a long rest in the open without risking exhaustion from cold.

gear.name: Canteen
gear.description: Holds 1 quart of water.

gear.name: MRE (ration)
gear.description: One day of food. Self-heating in modern and future eras.

gear.name: Compass
gear.description: Always know which way is north (on Earth-like worlds with a magnetic field).

gear.name: Water purification tablets
gear.description: Make 1 gallon of water safe to drink. 20 tablets.

gear.name: Vacuum suit
gear.description: Soft spacesuit with 6 hours of air, mag boots and a helmet light. Holed by a critical hit: lose 1 hour of air per round until patched (action, Mechanics DC 10 with a patch kit).

gear.name: Mag boots
gear.description: Walk on metal surfaces in zero gravity at half speed; cannot be knocked prone or pushed while active.

gear.name: Home computer
gear.description: 8-bit or early 16-bit desktop with a floppy drive and a 1200-baud modem. Dial into bulletin boards, phone-company switches and university mainframes. No internet: hacking a system requires its phone number or a physical terminal.

gear.name: Portable terminal
gear.description: Luggable computer with a built-in acoustic coupler. Counts as a hacking rig for phone-line intrusion.

gear.name: Magnetic tape reel
gear.description: Mainframe data storage. Reading one requires a compatible tape drive, found in corporate and government data centers.

gear.name: Laptop
gear.description: General-purpose computer. With the right software it counts as a hacking rig.

gear.name: Data slate
gear.description: Flexible tablet with holographic display; reads any common data format and stores a lifetime of records.

gear.name: Neural jack cable
gear.description: Connects a Synthetic or a cyber-equipped human directly to a port (the Synthetic's Data Link advantage requires it).

gear.name: 9mm rounds (50)
gear.description: Box of pistol ammunition, also fed by most SMGs. On a character sheet record as 'equipment' entry "9mm rounds (50)" and count down.

gear.name: .38 rounds (50)
gear.description: Revolver ammunition (.357 revolvers can also fire it).

gear.name: .45 rounds (50)
gear.description: Ammunition for .45 pistols and some SMGs.

gear.name: Magnum rounds (50)
gear.description: .357 or .44 magnum (specify).

gear.name: .22 rounds (100)
gear.description: Rimfire rounds for .22 pistols and rifles.

gear.name: Shotgun shells (25)
gear.description: 12-gauge buckshot or slugs (specify).

gear.name: Rifle rounds (60)
gear.description: Intermediate rifle cartridges (5.56mm or 7.62x39mm, specify) for assault rifles and carbines.

gear.name: Full-power rifle rounds (20)
gear.description: 7.62mm/.30-06/.308 for battle, hunting and sniper rifles.

gear.name: Machine-gun belt (100)
gear.description: Linked rounds for a light machine gun.

gear.name: Spare magazine
gear.description: Pre-loaded magazines make the weapon's listed reload possible; without one, reloading a detachable-magazine weapon takes an action and a free hand.

gear.name: Power cell
gear.description: Recharges an energy weapon's magazine to full; swapping cells is the weapon's reload. Recharging a spent cell takes 1 hour at a power outlet.

gear.name: Caseless magazine
gear.description: Full magazine for a caseless pistol or pulse rifle.

gear.name: Suppressor
gear.description: Threaded onto a pistol, SMG or rifle: the weapon gains the suppressed property (heard within about 60 ft). Reduces range by a quarter. Can't fit revolvers or shotguns. Illegal in many places.

gear.name: Gun cleaning kit
gear.description: Cleaning a weapon during a short rest means its first fumble before the next rest is a miss rather than a jam.

gear.name: Bipod
gear.description: When prone or braced, a Longarm or Heavy Weapon ignores the heavy property's STR penalty and the light machine gun's standing penalty.

gear.name: Smoke grenade
gear.description: Thrown 30/60 ft: creates a 20-ft-radius cloud of heavily obscuring smoke for 1 minute (10 rounds); a strong wind disperses it in 4 rounds.

gear.name: Body bag
gear.description: Holds one body. Two people can carry a filled bag at normal speed; one person drags it at half speed.

gear.name: Fake ID
gear.description: A cheap forgery passes casual inspection; a careful check is Investigation DC 12. Better forgeries are made with a Forgery kit.

gear.name: Chain and padlock
gear.description: Secures a door or vehicle; break it with STR DC 20 or bolt cutters.

gear.name: Fuel can (5 gal)
gear.description: Petrol. Makes 10 Molotov cocktails, or keeps a car running another 100 miles.
